source_title: City National Bank Expands in Los Angeles with New Inglewood Branch
source_excerpt:
New full-service location expands access to personalized banking for Inglewood's growing community of small businesses and homeowners
LOS ANGELES , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- City National Bank has opened a new branch in Inglewood, building its presence in the Los Angeles community and bringing personalized banking and financial services to support small business growth and homeownership in one of Southern California's most dynamic communities.
The 1,613-square foot branch, located at the corner of East Manchester Boulevard and South La Brea Avenue, is now open to serve individuals, families and businesses throughout Inglewood and neighboring communities with a full range of personal and business banking, mortgage, cash management and wealth management solutions. The location features multiple service and consultative desks, private meeting spaces and a 24-hour ATM, all designed to support the financial success of Inglewood's business owners and residents.
Inglewood is a vibrant, growing community attracting businesses of all sizes across hospitality, entertainment, healthcare, sports, aerospace and other key sectors. With major sports and entertainment venues, ongoing infrastructure projects and commercial activity, the city is transforming into a community ideal for small businesses and residents who intend to call Inglewood home for the long term.
"As Inglewood continues to evolve, we see a meaningful opportunity to build lasting relationships with the individuals and businesses shaping the community's future," said Lindsay Dunn, executive vice president and head of Personal & Business Banking. "We're committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their business and residents achieve homeownership through trusted personalized guidance."
City National is proud to already be part of Inglewood's rich history and strong community. In June, the bank hosted "Ask the Banker," a community education event empowering residents and business owners with financial guidance. The bank also partnered with Los Angeles Urban League to offer workshops on homeownership pathways, sponsored the Inglewood Music Festival, and donated school supplies and backpacks to local students at Woodworth Monroe School and Centinela School. City National also has plans to donate a book vending machine to a local elementary school in the coming weeks, expanding access to reading resources for young learners.
The Inglewood branch opening reflects City National's continued commitment to the LA region, following the opening of its Whittier branch in 2025 and the recent reopening of its Palisades Village branch following the 2025 LA wildfires. These investments showcase the bank's dedication to serving the diverse businesses and families throughout the greater LA area and making banking more accessible for everyone.
"Inglewood's mix of entertainment, healthcare and aerospace businesses creates real opportunities for local professionals and entrepreneurs, and our team is here to help them build stronger businesses and personal wealth," said Leo Pierre, branch manager. "We're honored to be part of Inglewood's next chapter."
Located at 130 East Manchester Boulevard, Inglewood, CA 90301 , the Inglewood branch is now fully open Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
City National will host a community grand opening celebration in early 2027 to mark the occasion; event details will be announced separately.
City National Bank is dedicated to helping clients thrive and communities prosper. Founded in 1954, City National is the largest bank headquartered in Los Angeles with $100 billion in assets as of July 31, 2026.
A subsidiary of Royal Bank of Canada, City National delivers personalized service and specialized expertise in wealth management and private banking, entertainment and sports banking, commercial banking, and consumer banking, with branches and banking offices in major markets across the Western, Mid-Atlantic and Southeast U.S. City National and its affiliates RBC Rochdale, RBC Securities and RBC Trust Company (Delaware) Limited manage or administer $113 billion in client investment assets. In 2025 alone, the company made charitable contributions of nearly $11 million to nonprofits that support the communities it serves.
City National Bank. Member FDIC. RBC Rochdale, LLC, is an SEC-registered investment adviser and wholly owned subsidiary of City National Bank. RBC Securities, Inc., is an SEC-registered investment adviser and broker-dealer, Member FINRA / SIPC , and an indirect, wholly owned subsidiary of Royal Bank of Canada. RBC Trust Company (Delaware) Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of City National Bank. City National Bank does business in the state of Florida as CN Bank. For more information, visit cnb.com .
